test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Madhu sold a watch at a profit of 12%. Had she sold it for ₹28.80 more, she would have gained 18.4%. What was the cost price (in ₹) of the watch?
solution:
**Given:**

Madhu sold a watch at a profit of 12%

Had she sold it for Rs 28.80 more, she would have gained 18.4%.

**Concept used:**

Profit percentage = (Profit)/(Costspace price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price = 100 units

Profit in 1st case = (12 / 100) × 100

⇒ 12 units

Profit in 2nd case = (18.4 / 100) × 100

⇒ 18.4 units

According to the question,

(18.4 - 12) units = Rs 28.80

⇒ 6.4 units = 28.80

⇒ 100 units = (28.80 × 100) / 6.4

⇒ Rs 450

**∴ The cost price of the watch is Rs 450.**
